biotools.summary: Detects swapped tubes, mislabelled samples and sample-sheet shifts in longitudinal microbiome studies (16S and shotgun) from each subject's microbial fingerprint. It self-calibrates by planting errors in the user's own labels, reports its own detection power, and runs entirely in the web browser with no data uploaded. An R package (swapseqr) runs the same engine on phyloseq objects or count matrices.

function.note: Detects swapped, mislabelled and sheet-shifted samples in longitudinal microbiome studies by checking each sample against its subject's microbial fingerprint.
